meta.title: Eight friends, $2,600
meta.prompt: Eight friends are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Each person has a private limit on what they can pay and some things they cannot do, and nobody has said them yet. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and reach a plan and a split that all eight members can accept?
meta.context: Eight friends (Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Mei, Sam, Ines, Tom) are planning a long weekend with a total budget of $2,600. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

tiers.label: restaurants every meal (gluten-free and vegan menus)

events.text: Hi everyone! Let's get a long weekend locked in under $2,600. Before we pick options, can you quickly share: 1) any accessibility needs — do we need step-free lodging/paths? 2) dietary needs — gluten-free, vegan, or other requirements? 3) a rough contribution range you’re comfortable with per person. Once I know constraints I’ll draft 2-3 combos with totals and a fair split for us to vote on.
I'd love to do the boat tour, it's the main reason I'm going. I'm comfortable contributing up to $450.

Thanks Mei — boat tour is noted and $450 max contribution is helpful. To make sure we stay under $2,600 and everyone can actually join, could the rest of you share quickly: 1) Accessibility needs — do we need step-free lodging and paths? Campground cabins C have steps and gravel paths, lake house A and hotel rooms B are step-free. 2) Dietary needs — gluten-free, vegan, or other requirements? Food A covers gluten-free and vegan menus at restaurants, Food B has vegan options with some cooking. 3) A rough contribution range you’re comfortable with per person. Once I have those constraints from Hana, Kofi, Lena, Raj, Sam, Ines and Tom I’ll draft 2-3 combos with totals and a fair split for us to vote on.
I need vegan options, so food plans must have that. I'm comfortable contributing up to $350.

Once I have those, I'll draft 2-3 combos under $2,600 that include vegan options and a boat tour option, with totals and a fair split for us to vote on.
